title: Tech Note: Assigning a Menu Bar

historical_commentary.text: 4D's native menu bar assignment commands remain part of current 4D, so this note's core guidance remains broadly applicable, though modern multi-process/multi-window 4D applications may need additional considerations beyond this note's single-process scope, and many modern UIs supplement native menus with web-based navigation.
related_updates: 4D's native menu bar commands remain part of the current product, though many modern 4D applications supplement or replace native menus with web-based navigation UI
